newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy 2H Dec diesel, jet fuel.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy 2H Dec diesel, jet fuel.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender seeking 160,000 barrels of gas oil and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel a CPC source said on Wednesday.
The combination cargo of 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil and jet A-1 is for delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo between December 19-20.
The tender closes on November 27 and is valid until the 28.

CPC bought its last middle-distillate cargo from Dutch trader Vitol at a premium of 67.5 cents per barrel for gas oil and 47.5 cents per barrel for jet fuel, both over Singapore quotes on a c-and-f basis for December 12-13 delivery.
